title: Alien waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- alien body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='20' ry='24' fill='#5ee68a'/>
  <!-- lighter belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='12' ry='16' fill='#a6f5c1'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#7cf0a3'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='15' ry='12' fill='#b6fbcd'/>
  <!-- left arm (down) -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='66' rx='6' ry='13' fill='#5ee68a' transform='rotate(20 28 66)'/>
  <!-- right arm waving up -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='44' rx='6' ry='14' fill='#5ee68a' transform='rotate(35 72 44)'/>
  <!-- waving hand -->
  <circle cx='77' cy='31' r='7' fill='#b6fbcd'/>
  <!-- fingers -->
  <ellipse cx='71' cy='25' rx='2' ry='3.5' fill='#d9ffe6'/>
  <ellipse cx='77' cy='23' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#d9ffe6'/>
  <ellipse cx='83' cy='25' rx='2' ry='3.5' fill='#d9ffe6'/>
  <!-- left hand -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='78' r='6' fill='#b6fbcd'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='33' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#3b2f6b'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='33' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#3b2f6b'/>
  <!-- eye glints -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='30' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='30' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- antenna stalk -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='8' width='3' height='10' fill='#4cc77a'/>
  <!-- antenna ball -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='7' r='5' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <circle cx='48.5' cy='5.5' r='1.8' fill='#fff3b0'/>
  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d='M43 44 Q50 50 57 44' stroke='#3b2f6b' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
